answer:
Verdict: The product portfolio is mixed — overall ad spend ₹6,79,481 bought 585 orders (₹1,162 ad spend per order), but a single unattributed row absorbed ₹2,32,698 (34.2% of spend) with no orders and is the biggest leak. Several small products are converting profitably, but a few high‑spend SKUs are marginal or losing efficiency.

What is working
- MistCalm Brush — ad spend ₹6,524; product-attributed net ROAS 2.08; 13 orders. Strong efficiency and a clear positive return on the ad dollars shown.  
- Play Scratch Lounge — ad spend ₹10,875; net ROAS 1.84; 15 orders. Good return with reasonable volume.  
- PawTech Cleaner (500ml) — ad spend ₹15,450; net ROAS 1.32; 16 orders. Healthy ROAS at moderate spend.  
- K9 Harness — ad spend ₹13,631; net ROAS 1.13; 13 orders. Small but profitable signal.  
- WildTrail Boots — ad spend ₹18,624; net ROAS 1.05; 22 orders. Near-breakeven but positive ROAS at scale.

Where money is leaking
- Unattributed / (not set) spend — ad spend ₹2,32,698 (34.2% of total) and recorded no orders. This is the single largest leak.  
- Pawveralls Suspender Boots — ad spend ₹77,085; net ROAS 1.00 (0.9976); 55 orders. Very large spend with essentially break‑even attributed net sales — high risk given product & operating costs not shown here.  
- WingBird Smart Flapping Toy — ad spend ₹34,348; net ROAS 0.69; 43 orders. High spend, low efficiency.  
- Ave Walk Harness Set — ad spend ₹6,451; net ROAS 0.14; 10 orders. Poor efficiency even at modest spend.

Why (what the data shows)
- Concentration: three largest spenders (including the unattributed row and Pawveralls) account for ~50.6% of spend; that concentrates risk.  
- Unattributed spend is the dominant immediate problem — a large amount of ad dollars is not tied to any product orders.  
- Several SKUs with high spend have net ROAS below 1.0 (less net sales than ad dollars), so they currently return less than the ad investment.

What I would do (ordered by money at stake)
- Immediately inspect the ₹2,32,698 unattributed spend: drill by campaign_name, ad_platform and creative. Check whether it’s a tracking/attribution issue or a true spend on non-converting placements. Confirm within 48–72 hours; if still unattributed and non-converting, reduce/stop that spend. (Check: drill to campaign-level.)  
- Reduce or reallocate budget from large, marginal SKUs: Pawveralls Suspender Boots (₹77,085, ROAS ≈1.00) and WingBird Toy (₹34,348, ROAS 0.69). Move at-risk budget to the top performers above and monitor 7-day performance. (Check: spend ÷ orders and ROAS over next 7 days.)  
- Investigate Ave Walk Harness Set (ROAS 0.14) and similar low-ROAS items; if creative/landing-page fixes are not found within 3 days, pause paid promotion. (Check: landing-page conversion and on-site funnel for this SKU.)
